title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in Arraytics Booktics booktics allows SQL… (CVE-2026-109894)
description: CVE-2026-109894 is a critical SQL Injection vulnerability in Arraytics Booktics affecting versions up to 1.0.29. It allows an attacker to inject malicious SQL commands due to improper neutralization of special elements in SQL queries. The vulnerability has a high CVSS score of 9.3, indicating network exploitable, no privileges required, no user interaction, with high confidentiality impact and low availability impact. No patch or remediation information is currently available.
aiSummary: This vulnerability in Arraytics Booktics (up to version 1.0.29) arises from improper neutralization of special elements used in SQL commands, enabling SQL Injection attacks (CWE-89). The flaw allows attackers to execute unauthorized SQL commands remotely without authentication or user interaction, potentially compromising confidentiality and causing limited availability impact. The CVSS 3.1 vector is AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:N/A:L, reflecting critical severity. No official patch or vendor advisory is provided in the data.
aiImpact: Successful exploitation could lead to unauthorized disclosure of sensitive data (high confidentiality impact) and partial denial of service (low availability impact). Integrity impact is not indicated. The vulnerability is remotely exploitable without authentication or user interaction, increasing risk.
